name: Full-plate
text:
*Armour value 4+*

Fighters equipped with this armour cannot be equipped with two-handed ranged weapons with the exception of a Brace of Pistols.

name: Warded Robes
text:
*Armour value 6+*

Roll a dice each time a fighter equipped with this armour is targeted by a spell cast by an enemy fighter. On a 4+, the spell has no effect on this fighter.

name: Ancient Banner
text:
*Held Item, Rare: 0-1*

While this fighter is on the battlefield, you can re-roll flee tests.

You can re-roll Willpower tests made by friendly fighters while they are within 12" of this fighter and this fighter is visible to them.

name: Bestial Companion
text:
*Item, Rare: 0-1*

Each time this fighter makes a melee attack, they can make 1 additional attack with the following weapon: Rend -1, Damage 2, Critical Damage d3+1, *Natural Weapon*.

*The Bestial Companion is not considered a separate fighter for any rules.*

name: Grimoire
text:
*Item*

Once per battle, after this fighter has made casting roll, you can re-roll the casting roll.

name: Shield
text:
*Held Item*

Improve this fighter's Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

name: Spirit Guardian
text:
*Item, Rare: 0-1*

Once per battle this fighter can use the following bonus action:

**Invoke Ethereal Protection [Bonus Action]:** Until the end of the round, this fighter ignores Rend for attacks that target them. In addition, each time they make a successful armour roll against a melee attack, the attacking fighters suffers 1 damage.

*The Spirit Guardian is not considered a separate fighter for any rules.*

name: Winged Familiar
text:
*Item, Rare 0-1*

Once per battle fighter can use the following bonus action:

**Harry [Bonus Action]:** Pick a visible enemy fighter within 24". Until the end of the round, that enemy fighter is *harried*. While a fighter is *harried*, each time they make a Move or Action they must pass a Willpower test, else they lose that Move or Action.
